sections.h2: Defence exports have risen every year since FY21, reaching Rs 38,424 crore

chart.title: Exports grew about 25-fold since FY17, with the latest jump the largest since FY19
chart.sub: Defence exports by financial year, Rs crore.
chart.source: Ministry of Defence figures as reported; FY18-FY21 from news coverage.

sections.means: Exports rose from Rs 1,522 crore in 2016-17 to Rs 38,424 crore, while production grew far more slowly.
sections.todo: Treat the exports-to-production ratio as indicative only, since the two series are measured differently.

sections.h2: Public-sector firms overtook private firms as the main exporters in 2025-26

chart.title: Public-sector exports rose 151% in one year, to Rs 21,071 crore
chart.sub: Defence exports in 2025-26 by seller type, Rs crore.
chart.source: Ministry of Defence figures as reported.

sections.means: Private exports still grew 14% to Rs 17,353 crore, so the record rests on a few state firms and large orders.
sections.todo: Watch whether private firms regain growth, since their two-year pace is about 7% a year.

sections.h2: Exports need about 9% a year to reach the 2029 target, production about 19%

chart.title: The export target needs less growth than recent years; production needs slightly more
chart.sub: Annual growth, %. Targets read as 2028-29 from the FY26 base.
chart.source: Ministry of Defence targets; growth rates as stated in the post.

sections.means: Exports need about 9% a year against 34% over the last three years, so the export goal looks likely to be met.
sections.todo: Track deliveries on the large domestic orders, since the 2029 production goal depends on them.
